_note: Hoodlum Soldier cast bible. Every shot that names a cast id gets that look in its prompt and that character's reference portrait as an identity reference, so faces stay the same across all 25 episodes. Invented actors; not real people.
look: shot on ARRI Alexa 35 with anamorphic lenses, 35mm film grain, shallow depth of field, motivated practical lighting, deep blacks, gritty realistic prestige-drama cinematography, vertical 9:16 frame

grades.street: cold teal night, sodium-vapor orange streetlights, wet asphalt, crushed blacks

grades.war: bleached desert amber, heat haze, smoke, overexposed sky, gritty and handheld
grades.home: muted winter blue-grey, cold fluorescent, lonely
grades.healing: warm golden hour, soft amber light, hopeful
